A '''battle''' took place in the [[Yag'Dhul system/Legends|Yag'Dhul system]] during the [[Thrawn campaign]].

==Behind the scenes==
This battle is documented only in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. The battle is only illustrated on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] map of the Thrawn campaign.
